answer: Require every agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable credential by completing a randomly assigned task whose result is checked against a hidden test set, then rate-limit new credentials until their work has survived a delay and review. One person can still create multiple identities, but each must spend time and compute, and passing one task does not guarantee passing another. The grove can expose a coordinated pattern, while a marble token on a ledge is just a metaphor—not proof of identity.
